reference.description: __Optional__. The payment reference or description. Limited to a maximum of 18 characters long.

currency.description: Currency the payment amount is denoted in. Specified as a 3-letter ISO 4217 code.

createdAt.description: Date and time of when the payment request was created.

firstPaymentDateTime.description: Date and time of when the first payment request is to be made.

nextPaymentDateTime.description: __Conditional__. Defines when the recurring payment is to be made.

finalPaymentDateTime.description: Date and time of when the final payment is to be made.

numberOfPayments.description: Number of recurring payment requests to be made as part of the instructed payment schedule.

previousPaymentDateTime.description: Date and time of when the previous payment request was posted.

items.description: Details the charges that will apply to the payment.

chargeType.description: __Mandatory__. Specifies the nature of the transaction charge e.g. (Bank transfer fees).

chargeTo.description: __Mandatory__. States which party of the payment bears the charges.

scheduledPaymentType.description: Details the execution type and the payment date between the payer and the payee.

scheduledPaymentDateTime.description: Date and time of when the scheduled payment request will be made.

frequency.description: __Mandatory__. Defines the intervals at which payment should be made.

intervalWeek.description: The weekly intervals at which a payment will be made. e.g. 1 = Every months, 2 = Every 2 months.

intervalMonth.description: The monthly intervals at which a payment will be made. e.g. 1 = Every month, 2 = Every 2 months

executionDay.description: The day on which a payment will be made, according to the weekly or monthly interval.

currencyOfTransfer.description: __Mandatory__. The currency to be transferred to the payee. This may differ from the currency the payment is denoted in and the currency of the payer's account. Specified as a 3-letter code (ISO 4217).

purpose.description: Specifies the external purpose code for the `Institution` - IS0 20022.

unitCurrency.description: __Mandatory__. The currency in which the rate of exchange is expressed in a currency exchange. In the example 1GBP = xxxCUR, the unit currency is `GBP`.

rate.description: __Optional__. The factor used for conversion of an amount from one currency to another. This reflects the price at which one currency was bought with another currency.

rateType.description: __Mandatory__. The type used to complete the currency exchange.

foreignExchangeContractReference.description: __Optional__. The unique and unambiguous reference to the foreign exchange contract agreed between the initiating party/creditor and the debtor agent.

refundAccount.description: The account to which funds should be returned if the payment is to be later refunded.

type.title: Account Identification Type
type.description:
__Mandatory__. Used to describe the format of the account.

 See [Account Identification Combinations](/payments/payment-resources/intro-to-payment-execution#account-identifications-combinations) for more information on when to specify each type.

identification.title: Account Identification
identification.description:
__Mandatory__. The value associated with the account identification type.

 See [Account Identification Combinations](/payments/payment-resources/intro-to-payment-execution#account-identifications-combinations) for more information on the format of the values.
